objective.title: UTMB · 171 km / 10 000 m D+
objective.experience: Three 80 km finishes, one DNF at 100 miles in 2025.
objective.constraints: Sessions in the morning, long run on Sunday, one recovery week every four weeks.

phases.name: Foundations & robustness
phases.description: Settle into mostly easy endurance, consistency and muscular robustness before adding demanding terrain.

phases.name: Trail-specific & durability
phases.description: Build vertical gain, power hiking, controlled descents, durability and the aid-station strategy, step by step.

phases.name: Taper
phases.description: Cut the load while keeping short specific reminders, to arrive fresh and confident on race day.

sessions.title: Optional aerobic ride
sessions.subtitle: 46 easy min · no impact
details: 10 min easing in with a fluid cadence
26 min of easy endurance, no pushing on the climbs
10 min very light, to finish fresher than you started
First session to drop if fatigue, sleep or a niggle gets worse

sessions.title: Easy endurance
sessions.subtitle: 41 min at conversational effort
details: Warm-up: 8 min very easy with dynamic mobility
Main block: 26 min in Z1/Z2, breathing stays conversational
Recovery: 2 min of walking if needed, with no catching up afterwards
Cool-down: 5 min very easy
Intent: bank useful volume with a relaxed stride

sessions.subtitle: 41 min at conversational effort

sessions.title: Strength & prehab
sessions.subtitle: Legs, ankles and downhill resilience
details: Warm-up: 5 min of hip and ankle mobility plus bodyweight squats
Block: 3 x 8 lunges or split squats per leg, controlled movement
Block: 3 x 10 single-leg deadlifts + 3 x 12 straight- and bent-knee calf raises

sessions.title: Uphill economy
sessions.subtitle: 52 min · precise, controlled blocks
details: Warm-up: 10 min easy with ankle mobility
Main block: 22 min in Z2, then 6 x 45 s uphill with a snappy stride
Recovery: 75 s of brisk walking after each rep
Cool-down: 8 min easy
Intent: improve climbing economy without piling up fatigue

sessions.title: Supplementary strength
sessions.subtitle: Legs, ankles and downhill resilience
details: Warm-up: 5 min of hip, ankle and trunk mobility
Block: 2 x 10 single-leg glute bridges + 2 x 12 bent-knee calf raises per side
Block: 2 x 30 s side plank per side + single-leg balance
Cool-down: 5 min of gentle mobility
Intent: consolidate without soreness before the running sessions

sessions.title: Long trail run
sessions.subtitle: 165 min on rolling terrain · 0 m gain this week
details: Warm-up: 10 min very easy, walking allowed at the start
Main block: 148 min in Z1/Z2, conversational and steady
Recovery: walk 2 min and cut the target if your stride falls apart
Cool-down: 5 min very easy, then your usual hydration
Terrain: pick a race-like profile; efficient power hiking on the steep sections
Descents: short, relaxed, controlled steps; no chasing top speed
Nutrition: work up the drink and carbs you tolerate, and the kit you plan to race in
Intent: build endurance and finish able to carry on a few more minutes
